scope: Independent hand-authored expectations for the first twelve address rows, at every seed and larger scale. These expectations do not run the generator's query logic.

first_12.sort_rule: Unicode code point ordering, object_id breaks ties; nulls last. Not locale collation.

required_later_product_tests: Authorization, publication, editing, paging, notebook and recovery behavior require real owning-module tests. Fixture availability is not an acceptance result.
